sn42.11:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā mallesu viharati uruvelakappaṃ nāma mallānaṃ nigamo.
sn42.11:1.2: atha kho bhadrako gāmaṇi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho bhadrako gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn42.11:1.3: sādhu me bhante bhagavā dukkhassa samudayañca atthagamañca desetūti.
sn42.11:1.4: ahañce te gāmaṇi atītaṃ addhānaṃ ārabbha dukkhassa samudayañca atthagamañca deseyyaṃ:
sn42.11:1.5: “evaṃ ahosi atītamaddhāna”nti, tatra te siyā kaṅkhā siyā vimati.
sn42.11:1.6: ahañce te gāmaṇi anāgatamaddhānaṃ ārabbha dukkhassa samudayañca atthagamañca deseyyaṃ:
sn42.11:1.7: “evaṃ bhavissati anāgatamaddhāna”nti, tatrāpi te siyā kaṅkhā siyā vimati.
sn42.11:1.8: apicāhaṃ gāmaṇi idheva nisinno ettha va te nisinnassa dukkhassa samudayañca atthagamañca desissāmi.
sn42.11:1.9: taṃ suṇohi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi, bhāsissāmīti.
sn42.11:1.10: evaṃ bhanteti kho bhadrako gāmaṇi bhagavato paccassosi.
sn42.11:2.2: atthi te uruvelakappe manussā yesante vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn42.11:2.3: atthi me bhante uruvelakappe manussā yesaṃ me vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn42.11:2.4: atthi pana te gāmaṇi uruvelakappe manussā yesante vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā nūppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn42.11:2.5: atthi me bhante uruvelakappe manussā yesaṃ me vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā nūppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn42.11:2.6: konu kho gāmaṇi hetu ko paccayo yena te ekaccānaṃ uruvelakappiyānaṃ manussānaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā? ko pana gāmaṇī hetu ko paccayo yena te ekaccānaṃ uruvelakappiyānaṃ manussānaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā nūppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn42.11:2.7: yesaṃ me bhante uruvelakappiyānaṃ manussānaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā, atthi me tesu chandarāgo.
sn42.11:2.8: yesaṃ pana me bhante uruvelakappiyānaṃ manussānaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā nūppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā, natthi me tesu chandarāgoti.
sn42.11:2.9: iminā tvaṃ gāmaṇi dhammena diṭṭhena viditena akālikena pattena pariyogāḷhena atītānāgate nayaṃ nehi,
sn42.11:2.10: yaṃ kho kiñci atītamaddhānaṃ dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajjati, sabbantaṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ.
sn42.11:2.12: yaṃ hi kiñci anāgatamaddhānaṃ dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajjissati, sabbantaṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ.
sn42.11:2.16: “yaṃ kiñci atītamaddhānaṃ dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajjati sabbantaṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ, chando hi mūlaṃ dukkhassa. yaṃ kiñci anāgatamaddhānaṃ dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajjissati sabbantaṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ,
sn42.11:2.18: atthi me bhante ciravāsī nāma kumāro, bahi āvasathe paṭivasati.
sn42.11:2.19: so khvāhaṃ bhante kālasseva vuṭṭhāya purisaṃ uyyojemi:
sn42.11:2.21: yāvakīvañca bhante so puriso nāgacchati tassa me hoteva aññathattaṃ;
sn42.11:2.22: mā heva ciravāsissa kumārassa kiñci ābādhayitthāti.
sn42.11:3.2: ciravāsissa te kumārassa vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn42.11:3.3: ciravāsissa me bhante kumārassa vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā jīvitassapi siyā aññathattaṃ, kimpana me nuppajjissanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn42.11:3.4: imināpi kho etaṃ gāmaṇi pariyāyena veditabbaṃ
sn42.11:3.5: “yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajjati, sabbantaṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ.
sn42.11:4.2: yadā te ciravāsissa mātā adiṭṭhā āsi assutā, ahosi ciravāsissa mātuyā chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti.
sn42.11:4.4: dassanaṃ vā te gāmaṇi āgamma savanaṃ vā te gāmaṇi āgamma evante ahosi:
sn42.11:4.5: ciravāsissa mātuyā chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vāti.
sn42.11:5.2: ciravāsissa mātuyā te vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn42.11:5.3: ciravāsissa mātuyā me bhante vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā jīvitassapi siyā aññathattaṃ, kimpana me nūppajjissanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn42.11:5.4: imināpi kho etaṃ gāmaṇi pariyāyena veditabbaṃ
sn42.11:5.5: yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajjati sabbantaṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ.
